messages:
Priya Bhatia: Huge shoutout to Riley Chen — found my bike lock + keys in the shed at 1am and dropped them on my desk this morning along with a little bag of cookies. Saved my week. THANK YOU :tada:

Riley Chen: no prob! left them on your desk at 9:12. cookies were in the pantry so I grabbed a few. :cookie:

Ava Gomez: absolute heroics. Returning sentimental keys + cookies = community MVP. Coffee on me next time? :coffee:

Jordan Park: +1. Riley, officially the locksmith and snack courier now. :medal_sports:

Priya Bhatia: seriously, you have no idea how relieved I am. That keychain was from my first hackathon. I owe you a crate of cookies on Friday standup. :relieved:

Riley Chen: glad it helped! Also thinking of putting a tiny tag up in the bike area so things stop getting forgotten. simple reminder sign.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Noted 3 :tada: reactions. Adding a quick kudos entry for Riley on the internal kudos page: https://kudos.redwood.internal/riley (automated note)

Ava Gomez: @Priya if you actually bring cookies I will help bake / bring toppings. :raised_hands:

Jordan Park: Also logistics note — can @Facilities consider a small lockbox or labelled hook at the bike shed? Might cut down on this.

Priya Bhatia: tagging @Facilities here. Forever grateful — you made my commute not-terrible today. :heart:

Facilities: Facilities: Great idea, thanks for flagging. We can put up a weatherproof box and a simple label this week. Will follow up on Slack with a photo of placement.
